result:
Both `__init__.py` files empty — no summary needed.

**graph/ingest.py** — Walks repo, AST-parses Python files into `GraphNode`/`GraphEdge` via `ModuleExtractor` (visitor for imports, classes, functions, calls). `ingest_repo()` orchestrates full pass: hash-based incrementality, two-pass call/import resolution (`_resolve`), orphan cleanup, test-linking. Unresolved calls kept, never dropped — feeds hallucination detection later.

**graph/query.py** — Read-only query layer (`GraphQuery`) over the store: `define`, `exists`, `callers`, `callees`, `tests_for`, `untested`, `import_cycles`, `unresolved_calls`, `file_dependencies`. Centerpiece is `context_for`: BM25 seed match + graph-relationship expansion (calls/contains/inherits/tests) with hop decay, each result tagged with reason. `render_relevant` formats output.

**graph/store.py** — `GraphStore`: SQLite-backed persistence for nodes/edges/files, one file under `.verity/`. Hand-rolled traversal (`neighbours`, `reachable` BFS, `cycles` iterative DFS) instead of networkx/Neo4j. Incrementality keyed on content hash, not mtime.

**consistency/check.py** — Checks agent claims against graph (`check_symbol_exists`, `check_symbol_relation`, `check_file_exists`) and against memory (`check_decision_resurfacing`, `check_constraint_violations`) — no model used. `run_consistency_check` orchestrates, degrading gracefully (UNVERIFIABLE) when graph/store missing. `render_report` formats.

**consistency/claims.py** — `extract_claims`: pulls SYMBOL_EXISTS/FILE_EXISTS/SYMBOL_RELATION claims out of agent text, deterministically, only from backtick-quoted spans plus a closed set of relation phrases (calls/inherits from/extends/imports, plus negated forms). Deliberately narrow — under-extraction over guessing.
